title: Discretionary exemption refused for plumbing fixtures and external-wall insulation (Martinborough)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Owners, through a licensed building practitioner, applied for a discretionary Schedule 1(2) exemption to install new plumbing fixtures and fibreglass insulation in an exterior wall cavity.
Authority questioned whether a Schedule 1(2) decision can be determined; the determination considers that reviewing the exercise of that discretion is appropriate.
Decision: authority incorrectly refused the Schedule 1(2) exemption; decision reversed and a new decision required.
